title: When the Letters Breaks
author: Paloma Lockridge
blurb: Mara Whitlock, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, has spent seven years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. But when a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
